info.title: Twilio - Insights
info.description:
The Twilio Insights v3 API provides semantic query access to Conversations
analytics data. Resources include synchronous Query, Metadata, and asynchronous
QueryJobs for long-running queries.

PaginationMeta.description:
The pagination metadata containing navigation tokens and result information.
By convention, this schema should be added to the response payload's
'meta' attribute.

key.description:
The key of the list property contains the actual data items.
This enables programmatic iteration over paginated results.

pageSize.description:
The actual number of items returned in this response.
May be less than the requested pageSize for the last page.

previousToken.description:
Token to fetch the previous page of results.
Only included if there is a previous page, otherwise omitted.

nextToken.description:
Token to fetch the next page of results.
Only included if there is a next page, otherwise omitted.

QueryDefinition.description: Structured query definition that specifies what data to retrieve and how to filter, group, and order it

measures.description: Array of measures to retrieve, representing quantitative values or metrics to be calculated

dimensions.description: Array of dimensions to retrieve, representing categorical attributes for grouping and organizing data

filters.description: Nested filter conditions. Always use `op` and `expressions`.

orderBy.description: Specifications for sorting the query results by specific fields in ascending or descending order

field.description: Dimension or measure to order by

direction.description: Sort order direction, ascending or descending

domain.description: The business domain to execute the query against
Indicates the business domain the query was executed against

items.description: Array of result objects containing the query results. Each object contains properties matching the requested measures and dimensions.
Query result object with dynamic properties based on requested measures and dimensions.

additionalProperties.description: Dynamic property values based on requested measures and dimensions.

InsightsMetadataResponse.description: Response containing metadata about available cubes, measures, and dimensions for a domain

domain.description: The business domain name for which metadata is being provided

cubes.description: List of data cubes available in the domain, each containing measures and dimensions

name.description: Name of the cube, used as a reference in queries

description.description: Human-readable description of what the cube represents

measures.description: List of measures available in the cube, representing quantitative values that can be aggregated

name.description: Identifier used to reference this measure in queries

description.description: Detailed explanation of what this measure represents

aggregation.description: Aggregation type for the measure (e.g., sum, count, average)

dimensions.description: List of dimensions available in the cube, representing categorical attributes for grouping data

name.description: Identifier used to reference this dimension in queries

description.description: Detailed explanation of what this dimension represents

type.description: Data type of the dimension (e.g., string, number, boolean, date)

LongRunningOperationStatus.description: The valid status values for long-running operations.

OperationError.description: The error details for a failed operation, embedded inside a 200 OK operation envelope.

httpStatusCode.description: HTTP status code that would have been returned for a synchronous failure

QueryJobSubmitResponse.description:
The initial 202 response for an async query submission.
Conforms to LongRunningOperation202Response from Twilio API Standards.

operationId.description: The unique identifier for the asynchronous query operation, in TTID format.

statusUrl.description: The URI to poll for operation status.

createdAt.description: The time when the operation was accepted, in RFC 3339 UTC format.

QueryJobStatusResponse.description:
The status response for an async query operation.
Conforms to LongRunningOperationStatusResponse from Twilio API Standards.

operationId.description: The unique identifier for the asynchronous query operation, in TTID format.

completedAt.description: The time when the operation reached a terminal state (CANCELLED, COMPLETED, or FAILED), in RFC 3339 UTC format. Null while the operation is still PENDING or RUNNING.

error.description: The error details, present only when status is FAILED.

resultUrl.description:
The URL to retrieve query results, present only when status is COMPLETED.
Supports pagination via the pageSize and pageToken query parameters.

resultId.description:
The identifier of the results resource, present only when status is COMPLETED.
Equal to operationId, since results are keyed by the operation ID.

resultRetentionPeriod.description: The duration for how long results are retained, in ISO 8601 format.

QueryJobListResponse.description: A paginated list of async query operations for the account.

MappingCategory.description:
The category of the custom field. Supported values:
- `MEASURE`: a numeric value that can be aggregated and queried as a
  measure in Conversations Insights.

SourceType.description:
The kind of entity that supplies the custom field's value. Each value has
a matching property on `entityMetadata` that carries that source's
details. Supported values:
- `INTELLIGENCE_OPERATOR`: the value is read from the output of a
  Conversational Intelligence operator. Details go in
  `entityMetadata.intelligenceOperator`.

IntelligenceOperatorSource.description:
Details of a custom field whose value is read from a Conversational
Intelligence operator's output. The operator must:
- have an active version;
- have `outputFormat` `JSON` (`TEXT` and `CLASSIFICATION` operators
  are rejected).

Requests that reference an ineligible operator are rejected with `400`.

operatorId.description:
The ID of the Conversational Intelligence operator whose output
supplies this field's value. Must match
`^intelligence_operator_[0-7][0-9a-z]{25}$`. Cannot be changed after
registration.

operatorName.description:
Optional, display-only name of the operator. Stored as supplied and
not validated against the operator.

field.description:
Path to the property in the operator's output schema that supplies
this field's value. Rules:
- one or two segments separated by `.` — a top-level property
  (`leadScore`) or one level of nesting (`scores.leadScore`);
- each segment contains only letters, digits and `_`; array
  indexing (such as `items[0]`) is not supported;
- the path must exist in the output schema of the operator's
  latest active version and resolve to a property of type `number`
  or `integer`.

EntityMetadata.description:
Identifies the entity that supplies this field's value. `sourceType`
selects the source, and the property named for that source carries its
details. Exactly that one source property must be present:

| `sourceType` | Required property |
|---|---|
| `INTELLIGENCE_OPERATOR` | `intelligenceOperator` |

A request whose `sourceType` doesn't match the source property it sends,
or that sends any other property, is rejected with `400`.

CustomFieldMappingRequest.description:
Registration payload for a single custom field. The mapping is created in
the account identified by the request's credentials.

name.description:
Name of the custom field, used to reference it in Insights queries.
Contains only letters, digits and `_`, and must not be empty.
Must be unique within the account across every `sourceType`;
registering an existing name returns `409`. Cannot be changed after
registration.

description.description:
Optional, free-text description of this custom field mapping, up to
150 characters. Display-only — not part of any uniqueness check.
description.example: Lead quality score derived from sentiment analysis

CustomFieldMappingUpdateRequest.description:
Partial update of a custom field mapping. Only properties present in the
body are changed; absent properties keep their current value. The body
must contain at least one change: an empty body is rejected with `400`.
Properties that cannot be updated (such as `name`, `category` or
`operatorId`) are rejected with `400` rather than ignored.

EntityMetadataUpdate.description:
Updatable subset of `entityMetadata`. `sourceType` must equal the
mapping's current `sourceType` (it cannot be changed), and the property
named for that source carries the fields to update:

| `sourceType` | Update property | Updatable fields |
|---|---|---|
| `INTELLIGENCE_OPERATOR` | `intelligenceOperator` | `field` |

IntelligenceOperatorSourceUpdate.description:
Updatable fields of a custom field mapping sourced from a Conversational
Intelligence operator. At least one field must be present. Currently
only `field` can be modified; `operatorId` and `operatorName` cannot be
updated.

field.description:
New path to the property in the operator's output schema. Follows the
same rules as `field` at registration: one or two `.`-separated
segments of letters, digits and `_`, resolving to a `number` or
`integer` property on the operator's latest active version.

id.description: The unique identifier of the custom field mapping.

name.description: Name of the custom field, unique within the account.

description.description:
Optional, free-text description supplied at registration time.
Display-only — not part of any uniqueness check.
description.example: Lead quality score derived from sentiment analysis

updatedAt.description: When the mapping was last modified via `PATCH`. Null until the first update.

CustomFieldMappingsList.description:
A page of custom field mappings registered for the account. The mappings
are under `items`, and `meta.key` is `items`.

CustomFieldCapacity.description:
Custom field mapping slot capacity for the account, by category. Only the
`measure` category is supported for now; the object is empty when custom
measures are not available for the account.

CategoryCapacity.description:
Slots consumed and remaining for the measure category. By default an
account can register up to 3 custom measures, so `consumed + remaining`
is the account's limit. Registering a new mapping when `remaining` is
`0` returns `403`.

consumed.description: Number of custom field mapping slots already registered.

remaining.description: Number of custom field mapping slots still available.

post.summary: Register a custom measure field mapping
post.description:
Registers a custom field for the account. `entityMetadata.sourceType`
selects where the field's value comes from, and the matching property on
`entityMetadata` (`intelligenceOperator` for `INTELLIGENCE_OPERATOR`)
carries its details. Only the `MEASURE` category is supported for now.

The request is validated before the mapping is created:
- `name` contains only letters, digits and `_`, and is not already
  registered for the account (otherwise `409`);
- `description`, when present, is at most 150 characters;
- for `INTELLIGENCE_OPERATOR`, the operator has an active version with
  `outputFormat` `JSON`, and `entityMetadata.intelligenceOperator.field`
  is one or two `.`-separated segments that resolve to a `number` or
  `integer` property in that version's output schema (otherwise `400`);
- the account has a free slot in the category; by default an account can
  register up to 3 custom measures (otherwise `403`). Use
  `GET /v3/ControlPlane/ConversationInsights/CustomFieldMappingsCapacity`
  to check the remaining slots.

Create-only: if a mapping with the same `name` already exists for the
account, `409` is returned with the existing mapping's `id` and nothing
is changed. To modify an existing mapping, use
`PATCH /v3/ControlPlane/ConversationInsights/CustomFieldMappings/{mappingId}`.

patch.description:
Partially updates an existing custom field mapping. Only the properties
present in the body are changed. The updatable properties depend on the
mapping's `sourceType`; for `INTELLIGENCE_OPERATOR`, only
`entityMetadata.intelligenceOperator.field` can be updated today.

The new `field` is validated the same way as at registration: it must be
one or two `.`-separated segments of letters, digits and `_`, and resolve
to a `number` or `integer` property in the output schema of the
operator's latest active version.

The mapping's `id`, `name`, `category`, `createdAt` and owning entity
never change. Sending a `field` value equal to the current one is a no-op that
returns `200` without modifying the mapping, so the operation is
idempotent. Supply `If-Match` with the `ETag` returned by `GET`, `POST`
or a previous `PATCH` to guard against concurrent updates.

Values already ingested are not recomputed; results processed after the
update use the new `field`.

parameters.name: mappingId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the custom field mapping, as returned in `id` when the mapping was created.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description:
ETag of the custom field mapping, as returned in the `ETag` response header.
When supplied, the update is applied only if the mapping has not changed
since that ETag was issued; otherwise `412` is returned.

400.description:
The request is invalid. One of:
- a malformed body, an empty body or source object (nothing to
  update), a missing `entityMetadata.sourceType`, or a `field` that
  fails its pattern;
- a property that cannot be updated (for example `name`,
  `category`, `operatorId`) is present;
- `entityMetadata.sourceType` does not match the mapping's current
  `sourceType`, or is not supported for updates;
- the new `field` does not resolve to a `number` or `integer`
  property on the operator's latest active version, or the operator
  no longer has an active `JSON` version.
